title: From maps to new thoughts: can place-cell indexing generate novel cortical states?
title_zh: 从地图到新思维：位置细胞索引能否生成新的皮层状态？
abstract: Constructing novel states from experience underpins imagination and abstraction. The hippocampal formation is thought to contribute by capturing the relational structure of experiences, but it remains unclear how its abstract relational codes are eventually translated into cortical content representations. I highlight that hippocampal-cortical indexing may scaffold the generation of new states.
abstract_zh: 从经验中构建新状态是想象和抽象的基础。人们认为海马体通过捕捉经验的关系结构来发挥作用，但其抽象关系编码最终如何转化为皮层内容表示仍不清楚。我指出海马-皮层索引可能为新状态的生成提供支架。
